_comment: Manual override lists for the CompanyCam photo quality gate (lib/companycam/photo-filter.js). blocked_photo_ids: never display, regardless of any heuristic. approved_photo_ids: bypass automated name/status heuristics (still subject to the block list). Edit by hand to hide or force-allow a specific photo, then rebuild the site.

_audit.method: vision review via contact sheets (audit/ pipeline), 6-agent parallel pass; post tag-backfill + photo-select (last-day window / 30-min gap / cap 8) selection
